Cybersecurity company Palo Alto Networks Inc. today announced that it has agreed to acquire artificial intelligence model training and inference startup Applied Compute Inc. in an all-stock deal valued at $4.5 billion. The news came alongside fiscal first-quarter earnings and revenue that were well ahead of Wall Street expectations. Shares of Palo Alto Networks rose more […]
